root_cause: The original append-only completion-supervisor snapshot calls workStore.list and recoveryStore.list; source store listDispatch issued a single unpaginated PostgREST select=*, without exact Count/Range. The REST server can return only first 1000 rows while original production contains 3313 AgentWork and 1055 RecoveryWork. The code treated the partial response as all rows.

evidence.truncation_consequence: EXPOSURE_RISK_CONFIRMED_IN_SOURCE; actual worker omission not yet independently observed

semantic_learning.cause: Unpaginated PostgREST GET ignored provider max rows, no independent source total or range
semantic_learning.prevention_rule: Fetch full append-only dispatch via stable tie-break order and exact-count Range windows until accumulated count equals provider count; any drift, truncation, dup or malformed provider response fails closed.
semantic_learning.next_owner: Original ONE BRAIN Reliability + Data Quality in existing completion-supervisor-bakfill workflow
